# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I’m hoping you can help me with a return.

I just received a laptop, and I’d like to return it for a full refund because I found a better deal somewhere else. I think I ordered it around April 2023, but I’m not completely sure.

My name is emma_smith_8564, and I’m in New York, New York, 10192. I don’t remember the email address tied to the order, unfortunately.

If it turns out it can’t be returned, could you please check whether it can still be canceled instead?

I can help with that, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please provide your:
- first name
- last name
- zip code

I can’t use a user ID alone for authentication, and I also can’t assist with cancellation unless we verify the account first.

Sure, of course.

First name: Emma  
Last name: Smith  
ZIP code: 10192

Thanks, Emma — you’re authenticated.

I can help with the return, but I need to identify which order contains the laptop. Your orders are:
- #W2417020
- #W5605613
- #W3614011

I can check them one by one, but first I should note:
- returns are only possible for delivered orders
- cancellations are only possible for pending orders
- for returns, refunds can only go to the original payment method or one of your existing gift cards

Your available refund methods are:
- original payment method on the order
- gift card: gift_card_8541487

Please tell me which order you want me to check first, or if you want me to check all three.
Thanks. I’m not sure which one is the laptop order, so could you please check all three? If possible, I’d prefer the refund go back to the original payment method.
